column3: Saori Route ・ Feasting Together at Comiket
A few days later...
Saori is probably busy, I haven't been able to contact her since.
However, I wasn't worried about my silent phone like before.
Because Saori has already firmly decided to push ahead with her feelings...
And thus, today's the first day of Summer Comiket.
Kuroneko was participating as a circle, and Kirino and I came to her stall to hang out-
I mean, we came to look around, without plans to buy anything but...
Like I said, there is no reason your narcissistic book would sell!
And like, what's with this massive reference book?
Why is it necessary to read a 500-page reference book for a doujinshi? Are you looking down on customers?
...I have no interest in ignorant people who cannot understand this book's vocabulary.
Just as people choose books, books choose people.
Of course, no one would pick a bitch like you, though.
Huh? You are totally annoying!
Those words prove my point.
Well, since it's come to this, I'll just put a curse on you as a comeback.
Huh...
Kirino and Kuroneko, as always, are at it again...
They control themselves when there are customers, but before you know it, they're going at each other with insults again...
Eh, it's like their way of communication. It's not a serious fight.
But still-
...I'm so bored.
With Kirino and Kuroneko entering their own world, I'm left with nothing to do...
If only there was something that would make my heart jump..
For example... a salesgirl in maid costume falling in love with me at first sight, and confessing...
A beauty in cosplay falling in love with me at first sight, and confessing...
When I think about it... that's all that comes to mind... impossible.
Falling in love at first sight is just an urban legend.
Kyousuke-san!
...Huh?
Ufufufu...
A beauty has appeared----(ﾟ∀ﾟ)----!!!!
And she's sweet and cute! Oh no, she's seriously my type!
Hey hey, who said falling in love at first sight is an urban legend?
If this isn't love at first sight, then what is this beating in my chest!
Wait, huh...?
Why does this person know my name?
Wait, you're Saori!
Fufufu, as always, your reactions are wonderful.
Because of that, my efforts up till now have been worth it.
As always... you haven't changed a bit.
What are you saying?
No matter what I look like, I am still me.
Pfft! Well, I guess you're right.
So... why are you here today?
Oh, right. I almost forgot about that!
I thought I would be able to see you if I came here...
So that means?
Yes, I've brought good news.
Saori talked about the past few days with a big grin on her face.
First, Saori confronting her parents.
Her parents got a huge shock after learning about her true feelings.
It appears that Saori has always been taught to be disciplined and conscientious by her parents.
A selfless, well-behaved Saori. This very person, for the first time, saying what she felt, really struck deeply within her parents.
They apologized saying, "We did not want to force our child into an unwanted future."
I see... so what about the engagement and your fiance?
My father cancelled it.
At one time, he wanted the wedding to be brought forward, but...
Without covering it up, I explained my reason, and he understood.
Hm. He's really befitting of a son of a big company's CEO, having such a big heart.
Really, it's a little unbelievable that they accepted it.
Yes. I told them that the reason I was able to tell them how I felt was because of support from a person named Kyousuke.
M-Me?
Who else can it be?
Don't stare at me! You're too dazzling for me to look at!
And I have one more thing to discuss with you...
What?
This wedding ceremony was called off, but...
There is another candidate for a fiance...
...Are you serious?
Yes, I am.
But, if the other party is willing, I'm...
Who is this other fiance candidate...
*sigh*...
Your only bad point is that dreadful thickheaded-ness.
Huh? What does that mean?
I have said this much and you still don't understand?
Saori dropped her shoulders and just stared at me.
Just curious, I looked behind me. Of course, no one was there.
...Wait... you don't mean...
...Really?
Yes.
I'm supposed to be... the one?
Yes.
I told my parents about when you had confessed to me, saying "I'll marry you!"
That is why they let me cancel the engagement.
Uhh, ahh...
I did say that. I definitely said I would marry Saori.
But I thought that was the only thing I could say to encourage her...
Or, were you lying then?
Of course not!? I'm always serious!!
Then there will not be any problems, right?
No problems...?
But, this is like... a proposal...
I feel...
With these two times, I have used my whole life's determination.
That is why, will you take responsibility?
U-Umm...
Urgh...
Twinkling in an adorable way like that...! Like that, just like that-
Even though she is bigger than me, she is irresistibly cute.
...Wait, being cute has nothing to do with being big.
Um... are you really fine with me?
...What are you saying?
I don't want it... unless it is with you.
Hey you two, what are you doing?
You two seem pretty intimate... you aren't keeping any secret from us, right?
What should we do, Saori?
They'll find out soon anyway. Besides...
I cannot hide something from my two precious friends.
Pfft! Is that so?
Kiririn-san, Kuroneko-san, please listen.
I'll be getting engaged to Kyousuke-san.
Heh, engaged.
Oh, that's an auspicious event...
Wait, engaged!?
W-Wait... What is the meaning of this...?
There is no further meaning, it is what it is...
I-I don't understand, I can't accept this!
Could you tell me the exact circumstances?
Of course! I'll explain clearly!
-Then Saori made a ω face and gave a cheerful smile.
